dct_description_sm: Since 2012, this case has been played 15095 times.

Team scenarios can be adversely affected by dominant players. This scenario explores the Proteus Effect and how it can be used to influence how team members interact with each other.
See https://olab.ca/olab-and-the-proteus-effect/ for further notes on the Proteus Effect.
